text_block_list.text:
The day of Gold City's debut finally
arrives. As we
head to the track...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: City! Look this way!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Do you have anything to say about your

upcoming debut?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Cityyyy! Good luuuuck!

The airport is abuzz with reporters and
fans
gathered to see her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on! The world is dying to know what this supermodel is up to!
choice_data_list: すみませんが、周りの迷惑になりますので
choice_data_list_en: Excuse me, but you're disturbing the people around you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
All her fans have been looking forward
to this! At
least give us a word or two to
share with—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then promise me you'll write exactly
what I'm
going to say.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Watch me as a runner.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone I'm more than just
looks.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh! So cooool!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The... definition of cool. Okay—just one
picture
to match your message for the
front page!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, her determination only accentuates
her
beauty! I have to get a good shot of
her face
while she's running!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They're still not looking past my
appearance. But,
well, that's the only
card I've played so far, so
what else can
you expect?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, they won't be talking like that
forever. I
have to prove myself, and
quickly!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Why should I relax when I'm supposed to
give it
my all?
choice_data_list: 肩の力、入りすぎないようにな
肩の力、入りすぎないようにね

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll surprise them by running so fast they
won't
have the chance to see my face!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
choice_data_list: 貴方らしく走ってきて
choice_data_list_en: Go out there and run your own race.
Just go out there and run your own race.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that, like, a given? I'm running to
be who I
am.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm a runner, through and through. I'll
show them
that today!
